nodes.label: Service Image 3 - Couple Reviewing Floor Plans
nodes.description: Lifestyle photo: a smiling middle-aged Asian couple on a cream sofa in a bright, minimal living room, reviewing architectural floor plans and printed documents on a wooden coffee table. Warm neutral palette (beige, wood, plants). Used as a marketing/service card visual.

nodes.label: Home Purchase / Renovation Planning
nodes.rationale: Floor plans plus paperwork signal a household planning a property purchase or build, which positions the KPR (mortgage) service as a calm, collaborative decision rather than a stressful transaction.

nodes.label: Warm Lifestyle Imagery Style
nodes.rationale: Natural light, neutral tones, and relaxed body language convey trust and approachability for a financial-service landing section.
